title: Delta chip
description: A change against a base as a small mono chip with an arrow: needle when up, heartwood when down, bark when flat. invert swaps the tones for a figure that is better lower. Renders nothing for null.

anatomy.description: A single span with data-slot="delta-chip" and data-tone (up, down, flat); the text is the formatted value followed by ↑, ↓ or -.

usage: The default formatter is a signed percentage to one decimal; pass any object with a format(number) method (an Intl.NumberFormat, or a custom one for points or runs) to write the change in its own unit.
Use invert for a figure that is better lower (runs allowed, turnovers): the arrow still follows the value's sign, only the tone swaps.
Pass null when there is no base to compare against; the chip renders nothing rather than a dash.
